biggest_gap: None blocking — Game A wins the scope. Residual defects to fix: (1) transfer-window news ('SUMMER WINDOW OPEN/SHUT', 'Deadline-day move: ...') falls through news_gen's category heuristic to cat=board with no matching uid prefix, so report_gen._board_review renders the WRONG body (current board confidence review) instead of the story — 3 of 91 messages in a 12-week sim; (2) monthly board reviews recompute confidence/finances at read time, so September and October reviews render byte-identical when read later (violates the snapshot discipline the media layer proudly enforces); (3) the same prospect can be scout-reported twice with byte-identical renders and scouted_pct stuck at 0%; (4) offer_selftest aborts on a save whose only offers are expired (brittle precondition, mechanism itself verified live).

history.gap: Inbox transfer offers (and all messages) have no game-state-changing actions; the inbox-generated offer stream is disconnected from the transfers market, making its 'decision required' items hollow.

Board & Finances tab is display-only — no board requests whose outcomes mutate real budgets, and no income/expenditure ledger; the inbox decision loop is now real (verified live sale), so the board half is what loses to FM.

No operating cash flow: wages never debited and matches earn nothing, so the balance is frozen outside transfers/board grants and the Income & Expenditure ledger stays empty — add monthly payroll and matchday/prize income entries to the existing ledger.

No people/media layer in the inbox — the operating economy, board requests and offer decisions are all verifiably live now, but every message is operational; add person-driven mail (milestones, morale, awards, injuries) with at least one respondable message type.

Verbatim quote repetition within a single simmed month — 3-line mind-game quote banks and single-template press pieces produced the same rival quote three times in six weeks; secondary: promised-battles pledges are never tracked/enforced, and mind-game FACTS blocks show read-time form instead of publication-time form.

All prior gaps verified fixed by blind 84-day sim (91 messages): zero verbatim quote/prose repetition (persona-conditioned 10-line banks, recency exclusion, verbatim guard), pledge made -> broken at deadline with real -12 morale + squad knock + follow-up mail, media facts snapshotted at publication (pub pos 8 vs live pos 2, rendered verbatim), board requests/offers/economy all mutate real state. Residual: window/deadline-day news mis-categorized as board and rendered with the wrong body via _board_review; board reviews recomputed at read time (two months render identical); duplicate identical scout re-reports of the same prospect.
